description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for managing 'tags' within a proxy management system, including creation, update, retrieval, listing, deletion, and activity tracking. It interacts with database models, external services, and management helpers, making it a core part of the tag management functionality.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_model_names(prisma_client, model_ids: list)
methods.description: Helper function that retrieves model names from the database given a list of model IDs.

methods.name: List["Deployment"] get_deployments_by_model( model: str, llm_router: "Router" )
methods.description: Retrieves deployment information for a given model identifier, either by ID or name.

methods.name: new_tag( tag: TagNewRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to create a new tag, including optional budget considerations and model associations.

methods.name: _add_tag_to_deployment(deployment: "Deployment", tag: str)
methods.description: Adds a specified tag to a deployment’s model parameters in the database.

methods.name: update_tag( tag: TagUpdateRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: API endpoint to update existing tag information, including description, models, and budget.

methods.name: info_tag( data: TagInfoRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about specified tags from the database.

methods.name: list_tags( user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Lists all tags with their associated budget info, including dynamically generated spend tags.

methods.name: delete_tag( data: TagDeleteRequest, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Deletes a specified tag from the database.

methods.name: get_tag_daily_activity( tags: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, )
methods.description: Retrieves paginated daily activity data for specified tags, filtered by date range and model.

ctags.name: get_tag_daily_activity
ctags.signature: ( tags: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, model: Optional[str] = None, api_key: Optional[str] = None, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 10, )
